definitions.explanation: The third-largest and southwesternmost of Japan's four main islands. It includes the prefectures of Fukuoka, Saga, Nagasaki, Kumamoto, Oita, Miyazaki, and Kagoshima. Known for its hot springs, volcanoes, and distinct regional cuisine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{九州|きゅうしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm traveling to Kyushu next month.

examples.japanese: {九州|きゅうしゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: Kyushu is famous for its many hot springs.

examples.japanese: {九州|きゅうしゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{活火山|かっかざん}→活火山：15901_kakkazan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧、{阿蘇山|あそさん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦{最大級|さいだいきゅう}→最大級：21467_saidaikyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧カルデラ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: Kyushu has many active volcanoes, and Mount Aso has one of the largest calderas in the world.

notes:
USAGE:
The name literally means "nine provinces" ({九|きゅう}{州|しゅう}), referring to the historical provinces that made up the island. Today it comprises seven prefectures. Okinawa is sometimes included in the broader {九州|きゅうしゅう} region for administrative purposes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {九州|きゅうしゅう}⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧ (the Kyushu region)
- {九州|きゅうしゅう}{新幹線|しんかんせん} (the Kyushu Shinkansen)
- {北|きた}{九州|きゅうしゅう} (Kitakyushu, northern Kyushu)
- {九州|きゅうしゅう}{大学|だいがく} (Kyushu University)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{本州|ほんしゅう}→本州：18528_honshuu⟧: Honshu (the largest main island)
- ⟦{四国|しこく}→四国：21447_shikoku⟧: Shikoku (the smallest main island)
- ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧: Hokkaido (the northernmost main island)
